name: No_3
short_caption: The robot brings its hands to its chest with a head tilt, then opens its arms wide in a sudden refusal or expansive gesture.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture, then quickly brings its hands up in front of its chest while tilting its head slightly to the right. It then sweeps both arms outward and downward in a broad, symmetrical gesture while returning its head to the center. Finally, the arms are brought smoothly back down to the sides, returning the robot to its neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The rapid outward sweep of the arms requires a clear lateral clearance zone of at least 0.6 meters on both sides of the robot.
